articles.title: “Reacher” Star Alan Ritchson and Wife Catherine Announce They’ve ‘Decided to End Our Marriage’ 20 Years After They Wed
articles.summary: “The best gift we can give one another — and our boys — right now is friendship... and a commitment to becoming the strongest co-parents we can be,” they sa...
articles.body:
Alan Ritchson and his wife, Catherine, announced they "have decided to end our marriage" in a joint Instagram post

They requested privacy for their family, emphasizing their focus on co-parenting their three sons while separated

The actor and Catherine met in high school, reconnected in college and got married 20 years ago in May 2006

Alan Ritchson and Catherine Ritchson are separating.

The Reacher star, 43, and his wife Catherine announced their split after two decades of marriage in a joint Instagram post shared on Saturday, Sept. 12.

"After twenty years together, Cat and I have decided to end our marriage and continue alongside one another in a different way," the post began.

"We grew up together. We built a life and a family together. And we are raising three incredible boys who will always be the center of our world," their statement continued, referring to their three sons Calem, Edan and Amory .

They went on to say that "nothing can diminish" the years that they spent together and "the love and respect we will always share."

"The best gift we can give one another — and our boys — right now is friendship, grace and a commitment to becoming the strongest co-parents we can be," they wrote, adding, "We also want to give each other room to grow into the people we are becoming."

They shared on the Instagram post, which restricted comments, that "change is hard enough without the whole world weighing in" and asked for "privacy" for their family at this time.

"We hope, especially for the sake of our boys, that you will allow our family to move through this chapter with privacy and compassion. Thanks for supporting us as we continue making the health and happiness of our family our priority," concluded the message, which was signed by "Cat and Alan."

TMZ , citing legal documents in a Sept. 12 report, said that "he actually filed for divorce in December" and that "the two reconciled back in March" before they shared their separation news on Instagram on Saturday.

PEOPLE reached out to Alan's reps for comment on Sept. 12 but did not receive an immediate response.

The Runner actor met Catherine while attending high school. They eventually reconnected when Catherine was attending the University of Florida when Alan visited Miami for a modeling shoot.

The couple wed on May 12, 2006. While they have mainly kept their relationship out of the spotlight, they have shared tidbits over the years.

In honor of their 19th wedding anniversary in 2025, Alan shared a video tribute about his wife on Instagram, showing the pair on the red carpet and with their family over the years.

"I'm the luckiest man alive. To be able to build the treasure that is our marriage and family is and always will be the greatest privilege and success of my life," he wrote at the time.

Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories.

" @catritchson you are wisdom personified. Strength incarnate. A tantalizing percolation of joy, adventure and love. The boys and I are so beyond blessed to be able to journey with and for you. Happy Mother's Day/19th Wedding anniversary momma. You deserve to be revered and celebrated forever and always," he added.

He notably did not share a tribute to celebrate their 20th anniversary in May 2026.

Catherine has also supported her husband over the years. When Season 3 of Reacher premiered in 2025, she celebrated with a post on Instagram , writing, "It is SO GOOD! I am SO PROUD!"

articles.title: Leilão de guitarras autografadas tem Foo Fighters e Calvin Harris  | G1
articles.standfirst: Itens como guitarras, discos de vinil e figurinos assinados por artistas do festival serão leiloados; valor arrecadado será destinado à doação de alimentos.
articles.summary: Itens como guitarras, discos de vinil e figurinos assinados por artistas do festival serão leiloados; valor arrecadado será destinado à doação de alimentos.
articles.body:
Leilão de guitarras autografadas tem Foo Fighters, Bring me The Horizon e Calvin Harris — Foto: Thaís Espírito Santo / g1

O leilão de itens autografados do Rock in Rio terá uma nova edição. A informação foi confirmada pela vice-presidente do festival, Roberta Medina, durante coletiva de imprensa neste domingo (13).

O site do leilão entra no ar nesta segunda-feira (14) e ficará aberto até 24 de setembro. Todo o valor arrecadado será destinado a ações de doação de alimentos.

“Comprem porque vai ter de uma galera. Tem Calvin Harris, Bring Me The Horizon, tem guitarras incríveis para a galera. Cada real volta para a doação de pratos de comida para quem precisa”, afirmou Medina.

A iniciativa, chamada Leilão Fans For Change, promove leilões beneficentes de guitarras autografadas e outros itens exclusivos do festival, em parceria com plataformas como a Play For a Cause. A ação é realizada desde 2015 em diferentes edições do Rock in Rio, incluindo Rio de Janeiro e Lisboa.

Entre os itens leiloados estão guitarras assinadas por artistas que participaram do festival, discos de vinil e figurinos.

articles.title: Joelma revela no Rock in Rio vontade de dar pausa na carreira: 'Para me cuidar' | G1
articles.standfirst: Cantora paraense, que estreia no Rock in Rio neste domingo (13), diz que gostaria de ficar alguns meses longe dos palcos após compromissos da ‘Calypso Tour Brasil’.
articles.summary: Cantora paraense, que estreia no Rock in Rio neste domingo (13), diz que gostaria de ficar alguns meses longe dos palcos após compromissos da ‘Calypso Tour Brasil’.
articles.body:
Joelma conversa com a imprensa no Rock in Rio 2026 — Foto: Felipe Fernandes/g1

Joelma revelou que tem vontade de dar uma pausa na carreira para cuidar de si.

Aos 52 anos, a cantora, que estreia no Rock in Rio neste domingo (13), no Palco Sunset, afirmou que gostaria de passar alguns meses longe dos palcos, embora ainda não tenha definido quando isso poderia acontecer.

HORÁRIOS ROCK IN RIO: Confira a programação completa

Famosos curtem último dia ; veja imagens

“Ninguém quer que eu me aposente, gente. Que isso? Eu já tenho 52, meu filho. Eu ainda consigo fazer meu trabalho, jogar meus cabelos em cima do meu salto, com muita alegria”, disse, em coletiva de imprensa no festival.

Joelma contou que, apesar de amar música, nunca teve o sonho de ser cantora.

“Eu não queria ser cantora apesar de amar música. Eu queria música para mim, no meu quarto. Mas eu não tive saída, fui escolhida para isso e com muito amor eu faço.”

Joelma negou, porém, que a pausa aconteceria logo depois do Rock in Rio. Ela lembrou que ainda tem compromissos marcados com a “Calypso Tour Brasil” e seguirá cumprindo as datas previstas.

Mas deixou em aberto a possibilidade de parar depois.

“Queria dar uma parada? Uns meses assim, para me cuidar. Se Deus disser sim, é sim”, afirmou.

A apresentação deste domingo marca a primeira participação de Joelma no Rock in Rio. No Palco Sunset, a cantora receberá Viviane Batidão como convidada.

articles.title: Looks Rock in Rio: botas e capas de chuva marcam o último dia | G1
articles.standfirst: Roupas precisaram ser adaptadas por conta do frio e da chuva no evento na Zona Sudoeste do Rio.
articles.summary: Os looks Rock in Rio foram adaptados com jaquetas de couro e botas para enfrentar o frio e a chuva que marcaram o encerramento do festival.
articles.body:
Botas foram um dos acessórios preferidos dos fãs no último dia de Rock in Rio — Foto: Thaís Espírito Santo/g1

O último dia de Rock in Rio, neste domingo (13), tem sido marcado por chuva desde os primeiros momentos, como já apontava a previsão do tempo.

Os looks do público precisaram ser adaptados por conta do frio e da chuva insistente: muitas roupas acabaram abafadas pelas capas de chuva. Outras, mais ousadas, preferiram deixar o look à mostra e torcer para as jaquetas de couro darem conta do recado.

Capas fizeram parte do visual de muitos fãs no último dia de Rock in Rio, neste domingo (13) — Foto: Thaís Espírito Santo/g1

Os sapatos oficiais para não passar muito perrengue têm sido os tênis e botas, principalmente de canos mais altos.

Amigas utilizam botas e casaco para curtir o último dia de Rock in Rio — Foto: Thaís Espírito Santo/g1 Rio

A carioca Flávia Campos não teve muita sorte com o calçado dela, que acabou descolando a sola pouco antes do evento. A solução foi envolvê-lo em esparadrapo.

“Eu vim com ela e estava sensacional, no BRT ela já deu uma descolada e eu pensei ‘ferrou’, mas os colegas tinham esparadrapo e me emprestaram para fazer essa gambiarra, que me salvou. Mas eu também coloquei sacola plástica junto com a meia pra não ficar com o pé muito molhado também”, explicou a jovem.

Fã usa botas no último dia do Rock in Rio — Foto: Thaís Espírito Santo/g1

articles.title: Carol Biazin reúne fãs fiéis e faz show de sintonia com o público no Sunset do Rock in Rio 2026 | G1
articles.standfirst: Cantora recebeu Joyce Alane no Palco Sunset, neste domingo (13), último dia do festival.
articles.summary: Cantora recebeu Joyce Alane no Palco Sunset, neste domingo (13), último dia do festival.
articles.body:
Após levar seu repertório ao Rock in Rio Lisboa em 2026, Carol Biazin reencontrou o festival em solo brasileiro. A recepção do público já indicava o tamanho da expectativa em torno da apresentação: ainda no início da programação deste domingo (13), fãs da cantora ocupavam o Palco Sunset para prestigiar uma das vozes mais populares da nova geração do pop nacional.

HORÁRIOS ROCK IN RIO: Confira a programação completa

Famosos curtem último dia ; veja imagens

Carol foi apresentada ao grande público ao chegar à final do The Voice Brasil em 2017. Desde então, construiu uma trajetória marcada pela mistura de pop, R&B, rap e MPB. Ao longo dos anos, também desenvolveu uma forte conexão com a comunidade LGBTQIA+, especialmente por abordar relacionamentos entre mulheres em suas canções.

Ao som de leques, as fãs aguardavam a entrada da artista e vibraram quando ela abriu o show com "Dilemas da Vida Moderna" e, na sequência, emendou "Low Profile".

A relação construída por Carol com seu público ficou evidente no Sunset. Em diversos momentos, bastava apontar o microfone para a plateia para ouvir os versos serem devolvidos em coro, como aconteceu em "Sou do Mundo".

"A Carol de muitos anos atrás já falava que um dia iria cantar para vocês. Hoje eu acordei e falei que seria um dia incrível, e assim será", disse antes de começar "Amor Traumatizado".

Para a participação de Joyce Alane, as duas cantaram "O Elefante da Sala". Poucos dias antes de se apresentar no Rock in Rio, Carol lançou o EP "Assumo os Riscos". Entre as seis faixas do projeto está "Tudo com Você", gravada com a pernambucana. A parceria ganhou uma versão ao vivo no Sunset. Na sequência, Joyce permaneceu sozinha no palco para interpretar "Idiota Raiz".

Carol Biazin se apresenta no Rock in Rio 2026 — Foto: Anderson Bordê/Agnews

Em "Ligações de Alma", Carol foi acompanhada por violinistas e pelo coro da plateia. "Muito barulho para minhas meninas das cordas", pediu a cantora.

Depois de agradecer a disposição dos fãs de ficarem na chuva, ela emendou "Códigos" e "Bagunça", seguida de uma performática "Tr*nsANte" e "real valor".

Na reta final do show, ela trouxe canções de seu trabalho mais recente, "BH" e "Morrer de viver", que já tem as letras decoradas pelos fãs. Para encerrar a apresentação, ela trouxe o hit "Te amo sem culpa".

Se o clima não colaborou, a resposta dos fãs compensou. Em uma tarde chuvosa na Cidade do Rock, Carol Biazin encontrou uma plateia disposta a acompanhá-la e confirmou o momento de consolidação que vive dentro do pop brasileiro.

articles.title: Mahira Khan says her second pregnancy wasn't planned, at 41 is physically more difficult: 'I was 24 when I first got pregnant, I have a grown up son, this required emotional adjustment'
articles.summary: Mahira Khan is embracing a new chapter in her life. The Pakistani actor, who is expecting her second child, recently opened up about experiencing preg.
articles.body: Mahira Khan is embracing a new chapter in her life. The Pakistani actor, who is expecting her second child, recently opened up about experiencing pregnancy again after 17 years and how different the journey feels this time around.Mahira became a mother for the first time in her 20s when she welcomed her son Azlan with then-husband Ali Askari. The couple, who got married in 2007, parted ways in 2015. Years later, Mahira found love again and married businessman Salim Karim in 2023.Now, almost three years into her second marriage, Mahira is preparing to welcome her second child. She announced her pregnancy on social media and later made her baby bump debut at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF), where she also spoke about the apprehension she felt about making such a personal moment public.For her TIFF appearance, the ‘Raees’ actor chose a dark-hued saree from Aafrinish by Niazi, featuring intricate detailing and paired with an embroidered dupatta. She completed the look with statement earrings, glam makeup and her hair styled in a loose braid.In an interview with Images Dawn, Mahira was asked whether she was nervous about revealing her pregnancy at TIFF. The actor's answer was “yes and no”. She explained that she is a private person, which made the idea of sharing such an intimate part of her life with the public somewhat daunting.Mahira also admitted that she was particularly conscious of what she would wear, as walking a red carpet while pregnant brought its own set of considerations. However, she eventually realised that she no longer wanted to hide the changes happening to her body and felt more comfortable embracing them.The actor also reflected on the striking contrast between her two pregnancies. Mahira was 24 when she was pregnant with Azlan, whereas she is now 41. She feels that not just her age but her outlook on life, her emotional state and her physical experience have changed considerably."The last time I was pregnant I was 24. I’m 41 now, so I’m literally a different woman … emotionally, physically, in every possible way. Pregnancy has been different this time around. At 24, I think I went through pregnancy with a certain innocence. I was excited, my health was great, and perhaps I didn’t think too much about everything that could happen. I just went with it.Mahira said the second pregnancy has been more demanding physically, even as she feels more emotionally aware of what she is experiencing. Used to a life filled with work and travel, the actor said she has had to adjust to moments when her body does not keep pace with what her mind wants to do.At the same time, that greater emotional awareness has also made her more conscious of how precious and fragile the experience is. Mahira acknowledged that her life was already well established, with a grown-up son, a career, routines and independence, and she had imagined what this phase of her life would look like."I have a grown-up son. I have my work, my routines, my independence. I had a version of what I thought this stage of my life was going to look like. To suddenly find myself starting this journey again after all these years has required a real emotional adjustment as well. You imagine a lot of things for yourself and for your life, and this wasn’t necessarily one of the things I had imagined at this point. But we plan and then God plans, and of course His plans are supreme."For Mahira, the unexpected pregnancy has ultimately become a lesson in letting go of the need to have every aspect of life planned. She described the experience as teaching her about surrender and accepting that some of life's biggest moments arrive when they are least expected.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: In 1999, James Cameron bought a 100-acre plot of land and spent 24 years building his home, which later became the birthplace of the ‘Avatar’ scripts
articles.summary: Discover the story behind James Cameron's breathtaking 100-acre home that took 24 years to build and served as the creative hub for the 'Avatar' scripts, now on sale for $33 million.
articles.body: James Cameron was quite dedicated to building the home he wanted when he bought a 100-acre property in 1999. The filmmaker bought the space to create his own sustainable home; however, unlike other celebrity houses that take two to three years to make, Cameron took his time with the property, and the home was finalised over the course of 24 years! Here is a look into the beloved actor’s Southern California home.About James Cameron’s 100-acre homeForbes reported that the actor invested a whopping USD 4.4 million to buy the 100-acre property years ago. Known as Tranquillity Base, the home sits atop scenic hills overlooking the Pacific Ocean. His property is located within Hollister Ranch, which in itself spans 14,400 acres. The space is a gated residential community located in Santa Barbara County. James Cameron isn't the only A-Lister living in the county; Jackson Browne, James Arness, and Yvon Chouinard, among many others, also own property there. The property also offers residents views and access to private beaches and hiking trails.More about James Cameron’s main residenceThe main house on his property itself spans 8,000 square feet and consists of interconnected structures. The entire space was designed by Hollister Ranch builder Bob Curtis. During the interview with the outlet, Cameron opened up about the property and shared, “It feels rural, but it’s also quite bold, architecturally. It’s very comfortable. It’s not precious.” The entire home is filled to the brim with Balinese and Indonesian-inspired furnishings to add a touch of culture to the modern home. He also shared that there is a Dionysus head in the living room that he got from a New York hotel.James Cameron's 100-acre home became the birthplace of 'Avatar'During the interview, he also revealed that the upper library area was his sanctuary and the entire home became a place of inspiration. The house was also the birthplace of the ‘Avatar’ stories, since this is where Cameron wrote the scripts for the billion-dollar films. The separate 2,000-square-foot guest house became another secluded workspace for Cameron while he worked on his films.The star also opted to keep his home sustainable and green and had solar panels installed to save energy. He also had a 24,000-square-foot barn area that he used to store helicopters, submarines, and robotic equipment for expeditions. There is also a tennis court and a helipad on his property, along with paddocks and ranch offices.James Cameron puts his coastal haven up for saleIn 2023, multiple reports revealed that the beloved star has officially put his cliffside home on the market. Valued at USD 33 million, the filmmaker has been ready since then to part ways with the breathtaking space.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Quote of the day by Judi Dench: ‘It takes courage to recognise the real as opposed to the convenient,’ a powerful life lesson explaining that it takes ultimate strength to face an uncomfortable truth
articles.summary: Explore Judi Dench's inspiring quote on recognizing uncomfortable truths versus convenient lies, reflecting on personal growth and resilience.
articles.body: Judi Dench has spent much of her career playing characters who are anything but simple. From powerful figures to deeply complicated personalities, her performances have often explored the choices people make when emotions, relationships and difficult truths clash. One of her most striking lines comes from a character who observes the lives of others with an unusually sharp eye. The thought behind those words is simple, but familiar to many of us.Today’s quote of the day by Judi Dench reads: 'It takes courage to recognise the real as opposed to the convenient.'What does the quote by Judi Dench mean?The line is spoken by Barbara Covett, the character played by Judi Dench in the 2006 film ‘Notes on a Scandal’. Barbara is someone who spends much of the story observing the lives and relationships of people around her. Her comment touches on something quite familiar: knowing that a situation is not right does not always make it easy to accept. In the quote, “the real” stands for what is actually happening, even when it is unpleasant. “The convenient,” on the other hand, is the version of a situation that is easier to live with. It could be staying in a relationship that has run its course, refusing to accept a poor decision or putting off a change because the present situation feels safer. Once the situation is seen for what it is, there is a better chance of deciding how to deal with it and what direction to take next.How is the quote by Judi Dench relevant today?Admitting the truth doesn't come easy to many. Thus, people often look for a pleasant way out instead. The pressure from family, work, or difficult life choices can make people avoid or deny uncomfortable truths because facing them is hard.Facing reality does not mean viewing everything negatively. It means heading on a path to accept the situation without denying reality. That honesty can be uncomfortable, but it can also prevent people from remaining stuck simply because change feels difficult.The quote also connects with personal growth. A person cannot work on a problem they refuse to recognise. Accepting what is real can therefore become the starting point for making a different decision, setting a boundary or moving forward.Early life of Judi DenchShe was born on December 9, 1934, in York, England. She gained an interest in acting while growing up and later studied at London's Central School of Speech Training and Dramatic Art.In the 1950s, she began her professional stage career and gradually established herself as one of Britain's top actresses. Her early recognition came through theatre, especially with the Royal Shakespeare Company.Working in theatre allowed her to play many different types of roles. Through different roles, she became known for expressing emotions convincingly and adapting to different characters, qualities that later became the hallmark of her film and television career.Judi Dench’s rise to fameIn 1964, she made her film debut in ‘The Third Secret’. She continued to grow, gaining experience and achieving success in both television and theatre over many years. Her profile gradually expanded when she was cast as M in the James Bond film ‘GoldenEye’ in 1995.She returned as M in several Bond films and continued to balance the franchise with challenging dramatic roles. Her performance as Queen Victoria in ‘Mrs. Brown’ brought an Academy Award nomination, while her portrayal of Queen Elizabeth I in ‘Shakespeare in Love’ earned her the Oscar for Best Supporting Actress. Over the years, Dench also appeared in films such as ‘Chocolate’, ‘Iris’, ‘Notes on a Scandal’, ‘Philomena’ and ‘Belfast’. Several of these performances brought her further Academy Award nominations and added to her reputation as one of Britain’s most accomplished actresses.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Silvia Bronchalo, madre de Daniel Sancho, rompe su silencio: "Prefieren aislarle más, que sólo se relacione con presos y con ellos"
articles.standfirst: Critica a Carmen Balfagón, abogada del equipo legal del detenido en Tailandia
articles.summary: Critica a Carmen Balfagón, abogada del equipo legal del detenido en Tailandia
articles.body: La madre de Daniel Sancho, Silvia Bronchalo, ha estallado contra la abogada Carmen Balfagón, del equipo legal de su hijo. A través de un mensaje leído en el programa 'Fiesta', de Telecinco. "A la señora Balfagón lo que le preocupa no es mi relación con Daniel. Lo que le preocupa es que ya no mando al conductor una vez por semana con dinero y comidas a prisión para Daniel, ni más transferencias ni más viajes. ¿De eso no hablan, verdad?", ha comentado Silvia Bronchalo en su mensaje, enviado a uno de los colaboradores del programa y leído en el citado espacio. "En vez de agradecer que alguien mande dinero, comida y que vayan a verle, prefieren aislarle más y que sólo se relacionen con presos y con ellos. Nadie más ha ido a verle desde la lectura de la sentencia. Nadie. No sé si sabrán ubicar dónde se encuentra la prisión de Surat Thani en el mapa. ¿Eso es amor?", ha insistido Silvia Bronchalo. El mensaje de Silvia Bronchalo ha sido interpretado en el programa como un dardo al padre de Daniel, Rodolfo Sancho. "Lleva más de dos años sin ir. Debería ir el padre a la lectura del recurso, que parece ser que es el único nexo de unión", han opinado desde el espacio de Telecinco. Daniel Sancho se encuentra actualmente preso en la cárcel de Surat Thani, en Tailandia, a la espera de la lectura del recurso a la sentencia presentado por su defensa. El Tribunal de Apelaciones de Phuket ya ha redactado la sentencia y la ha enviado al Tribunal Provincial de Koh Samui, aunque todavía no hay una fecha para que salga a la luz. El español está condenado a cadena perpetua por asesinato con premeditación y la defensa buscar que se rebajen los cargos a homicidio imprudente.

images.caption: Rodolfo Sancho y Silvia Bronchalo, padres de Daniel Sancho. EFE
